scope: The actual sanitized-css content model in the template namespace, selected by MediaWiki configuration rather than a filename suffix.
retention: Declaration property and literal normalized value
Ordered selector list and native parser scope prefix
Enclosing media, supports and layer conditions in their original nesting order
Important flag, duplicate declaration multiplicity and source cascade order
Rule existence, including rejected selector lists
Quoted strings and comments are lexically distinct

automaticRepairs.fallback: One literal three-, four-, six- or eight-digit hexadecimal color
automaticRepairs.conversion: Four physical side color properties at the exact original declaration position
guards: No local redefinition of the audited single-color token
No unknown, differently cased or multi-component variable
Important flag and cascade order remain unchanged
At most eight finite declarations in one sheet

automaticRepairs.value: Exactly 24 followed by whitespace and px, with optional important
guards: The sole repair candidate in the complete sheet
The original native sanitizer rejects precisely this declaration
The corrected value is accepted without any other lost declaration, value, rule or condition

nativeAcceptance: Two read-only GET TemplateSandbox parses, exact current source and candidate binding, complete contextual retention, no candidate diagnostic, no unrelated original rejection. A stale draft, unavailable API, oversized GET, or unproved grammar cannot authorize a write to the local editor.
responsiveCoverage: Widths 320, 375, 768, 1280 and 1920, two color themes, expanded and collapsed synthetic template layouts. Literal source shorthand is compared with independently native-accepted longhands. No full-skin reproduction or arbitrary navbox resizing is claimed.
excluded: No blanket group width, font size, line break or nowrap rewrite
No generic unsupported-property deletion or guessed selector substitution
No article transformation in a CSS editor
No Wikipedia write, token request, publication or account access in tests
